event_generation.intro.text: Create the real training events of one or two weeks from the saved training plan. Preview first: nothing is written until you confirm. Generating a week again rebuilds only events that were not edited by hand and have no answers; the others are kept and listed so you can fix them by hand.

event_generation.empty.text: The plan has no trainings in these weeks.

event_generation.nothing.text: Nothing to create, rebuild, or remove: the events of these weeks already match the plan.

event_generation.nothing_changed.text: Nothing changed: the events of these weeks already matched the plan.

event_generation.generated.text: Events generated: {created} created, {rebuilt} rebuilt, {removed} removed, {kept} kept.

event_generation.kept_intro.text: These events are not changed. Fix them by hand if the plan changed.

event_generation.reason.time_skipped.text: time does not exist on that day (clock change)

event_generation.error.invalid_week.text: Choose one or two weeks that fall inside the season part.
